sierra.name: SIERRA
sierra.subtitle: Andes & Mountains
sierra.title: Andean Sierra - Urus
sierra.subtitle2: The people who float between sky and water
sierra.question: What is the most surprising exponent of living history in the Andes?
sierra.description: On Lake Titicaca, the Urus built floating islands from totora reeds and keep ancestral traditions alive. Their handcrafted textiles and crafts, full of color and symbolism, tell stories of the lake, the sky, and a people who have learned to coexist with nature for centuries.

urus.name: Urus
urus.description: On the floating islands of the Urus in Puno, discover an ancestral culture that lives on water, with unique traditions that continue to amaze the world.

crafts.name: Handicrafts
crafts.description: Capital of the Inca Empire, fusing Spanish colonial architecture with Inca walls in perfect harmony.

textiles.name: Artisan Textiles
textiles.description: Fertile lands that fed the Inca Empire, surrounded by traditional villages and spectacular landscapes.

qalasaya.title: Qalasaya
qalasaya.subtitle: This sacred precinct was closely linked to astronomical observation and sun worship, being a key space for religious and social ceremonies. Its carved stone structures reflect deep architectural knowledge and a spiritual relationship with nature and the cycles of time.

pukara.title: Pukara
pukara.subtitle: Pukara is one of the oldest cultural centers of the Peruvian highlands. Famous for its ceramics and stone sculptures, this sacred place reveals the origin of Andean symbols that still endure. Walking through Pukara is traveling to the beginnings of Andean civilization.

temple.title: White and Red Temple
temple.subtitle: This temple stands out for its unique combination of colors and symbolism. Surrounded by Andean landscapes, it represents the fusion between ancestral spirituality and colonial influence. A place that invites contemplation and encounter with the living history of the region.

costa.name: COAST
costa.subtitle: Beaches & Desert
costa.title: Peruvian Coast
costa.subtitle2: Where the desert meets the sea
costa.question: What awaits you on the Peruvian coast?
costa.description: From paradisiacal beaches to desert oases, the Peruvian coast will surprise you with its diversity of landscapes and rich history.

nazca.name: Nazca Lines
nazca.description: Enigmatic geometric and zoomorphic figures visible only from the air, a world archaeological mystery.

beaches.name: Northern Beaches
beaches.description: Warm waters, perfect waves for surfing, and pristine beaches on the northern Peruvian coast.

gastronomy.name: Lima Gastronomy
gastronomy.description: Gastronomic capital of America, fusing indigenous, Spanish, African, and Asian traditions.

selva.name: JUNGLE
selva.subtitle: Amazon & Biodiversity
selva.title: Amazon Jungle
selva.subtitle2: The green lung of the planet
selva.question: Ready to venture into the Peruvian Amazon?
selva.description: The Peruvian jungle is home to one of the richest biodiversities on the planet. An adventure that will change your perspective of the world.

tambopata.name: Tambopata Reserve
tambopata.description: Paradise of biodiversity with macaw clay licks, hidden lakes, and intact primary forest.

amazon.name: Amazon River
amazon.description: The world's mightiest river, vital artery of the jungle and home to riverside communities.

manu.name: Manu National Park
manu.description: Biosphere Reserve with one of the greatest biological diversities on the planet.

manu.title: Manu - National Park
manu.subtitle: Where the lord of the skies reveals itself

hero.description: More than a tour operator. We are your local connection to Peru's soul, combining authentic experiences with sustainable and respectful tourism.

mission.title: OUR MISSION
mission.description: Share with the world the cultural and natural wealth of the Andes, offering authentic travel experiences that connect each visitor with Pachamama, Aymara and Quechua traditions, and the warmth of our people. We promote responsible and sustainable tourism that honors our roots and strengthens our communities.

vision.title: OUR VISION
vision.description: To be a leading agency in experiential and adventure tourism in the Andean highlands, recognized for rescuing and spreading the Aymara and Quechua cultural legacy, promoting a balance between the traveler, nature and our ancestral customs.

card1.title: Perfect Balance
card1.description: We promote a balance between the traveler, nature and our ancestral customs, creating experiences that respect Pachamama and enrich the visitor.

card2.title: Cultural Legacy
card2.description: Recognized for rescuing and spreading the Aymara and Quechua cultural legacy, positioning tourism as a tool to preserve and revalue Andean cultural identity.

card3.title: Experiential Experiences
card3.description: Specialists in experiential tourism that allows the traveler to immerse themselves in the daily and spiritual life of Andean communities.

integratedExperiences.title: Integrated Experiences
integratedExperiences.description: Design experiences that integrate landscapes, history and living Andean traditions through festivals, gastronomy, craftsmanship and coexistence with communities.

communityTourism.title: Community Tourism
communityTourism.description: Promote sustainable and community tourism in partnership with local families and communities, generating fair and sustainable income.

andeanWorldview.title: Andean Worldview
andeanWorldview.description: Foster respect and appreciation for the Andean worldview, transmitting values such as ayni (reciprocity) and harmony with nature.

andeanHospitality.title: Andean Hospitality
andeanHospitality.description: Offer a safe, reliable and personalized service, with the unique stamp of highland hospitality.

regionalDevelopment.title: Regional Development
regionalDevelopment.description: Contribute to the economic and cultural development of our region, strengthening pride in our roots and preserving cultural identity.

jorge.name: Jorge Cruz
jorge.description: Specialist in designing personalized experiences and ensuring that each traveler finds the perfect adventure in the Andes.

jacqueline.name: Jacqueline Mamani
jacqueline.description: Responsible for coordinating all the details to make your trip perfect, from accommodation to special activities.

cta.description: We design unique experiences that connect with the Andean essence
